SELECT i.*,c.location,c.position AS bag_position,'' AS equipment_slot,o.offer_id,o.shop_id,o.price_yang,o.revision AS offer_revision,s.display_name AS shop_name FROM shop_offers o JOIN account_shops s ON s.shop_id=o.shop_id JOIN item_instances i ON i.uid=o.item_uid JOIN item_custody c ON c.uid=i.uid WHERE s.status='active' AND i.definition_id=:definition AND i.upgrade_level BETWEEN :upgrade_min AND :upgrade_max AND o.price_yang BETWEEN :price_min AND :price_max AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM item_affix_index a WHERE a.uid=i.uid AND a.stat_id=:stat_0 AND a.value>=:minimum_0) ORDER BY o.price_yang ASC,o.offer_id ASC LIMIT :row_limit;
definition	s	iron_sword
upgrade_min	i	0
upgrade_max	i	9
price_min	i	0
price_max	i	9000000000000000
stat_0	s	monster_damage
minimum_0	i	0
row_limit	i	51
